title: Unwonted
summary: UNWONTED, adjective 1. Unaccustomed; unused; not made familiar by practice; as a child unwonted to strangers; sea calves unwonted to fresh water. 2. Uncommon; unusual; infrequent; rare; as an unwonted

inlines.v: UNWONTED, adjective 1. Unaccustomed; unused; not made familiar by practice; as a child unwonted to strangers; sea calves unwonted to fresh water. 2. Uncommon; unusual; infrequent; rare; as an unwonted meteor; unwonted changes.
